entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-26
entry.content:
Issues

    12.0.0

    12.0.0

    12.0.0

    12.0.0
  • Support for DragonFly BSD #138383
  • [.NET 11 regression] Uri.IsWellFormedUriString fails on relative URI with escaped Unicode symbols #138381

    12.0.0

    12.0.0
  • [.NET 10] AV in `TGcInfoDecoder::EnumerateLiveSlots` (`BitStreamReader::Skip`) when a GC scans a frame aborted by a throw in a method with a large compressed call-site table #138328
